description: A subscription route (OpenCode Go, /zen/go/ in the base URL) that is down must not silently burn a paid key: the configured chatgpt fallback is skipped with a status line naming failover_allow_paid, and the run fails with the primary's provider error.

setup_home_files.config.toml:
provider = "opencode-go"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1/zen/go"
model = "kimi-k3"
fallback_providers = ["chatgpt"]
[auto_continue]
enabled = false
